svg.title: When not to rewrite
svg.text: Three ways a change to the question goes wrong.
MATCHED WORD BY WORD, THE MAP DRIFTS
“Can I give my one-time code to someone from IT?”
11 of 29 new questions touched instead of 1
TRUE IN GENERAL, WRONG FOR THE QUESTION
“Do I need a receipt for a USD 40 dinner?”
needs “every expense over USD 25”, not the meal limit
A GUARD CHECKS FORM, NOT MEANING
a dad can be the primary caregiver: 16 weeks, not 6
exact values · who is asking: permissions come from the login
